edges.reason: Mossy stone brick stairs are at the end of the corridor past the potted bamboo landmark; bamboo serves as the navigation waypoint
Stone brick wall blocks are in the underground room accessed by descending the mossy stone brick stairs
Ancient debris is embedded in the underground room walls, accessed by descending the mossy stairs
Zombie guards the underground room where ancient debris is located; mining in proximity engages the zombie
Spider is in the east corridor beyond the zombie's underground room; player must clear zombie to safely proceed
Campfire room is accessed through the corridor past the spider; spider must be defeated to safely reach it
Furnace in the campfire room is needed to smelt raw mutton into cooked mutton
Blue terracotta forms the walls of the campfire room; player must reach the room to access and mine them
Crafting table in the campfire room is required to craft leather chestplate from leather in inventory
Crafting table in the campfire room is required to craft end stone bricks from end stone in inventory
